basis: The deterministic transport correction succeeds, but current authoritative OSF documentation does not establish that every provider-visible license and draft artifact can be enumerated and frozen before submission or that the automatic-approval lifecycle can be durably controlled through a documented complete interface.

authoritativePropertyEvaluation.basis: OSF documents Create Draft from scratch and an editable autosaved draft before submission.
OSF documents draft file preview and general API download links, but not one complete stable enumeration and byte-redownload contract for every draft and provider-generated artifact.
OSF documents selecting an embargo end date at submission for up to four years.
The API describes in-progress responses as private; OSF documents pending registrations as contributor-only and approved embargoed registrations as private.

OSF documents immutable submitted files and that the registration created date is the submission date, but the complete pending-to-registered identity receipt is not documented as one stable interface contract.
OSF documents admin approval or rejection through notification email and automatic approval after the bounded interval; no durable machine-controllable terminal-action interface is established.
Registered files are immutable and downloadable in documented OSF interfaces, but complete reconciliation of submission-time generated artifacts remains unresolved.

blockingFindings.finding: OSF says a project-affiliated license is automatically uploaded when submitted, but does not specify the artifact's exact name, bytes, or pre-submission availability.
Authoritative documentation does not establish enumeration and exact-byte redownload of every provider-visible or provider-generated draft artifact through one stable interface.
Approval and rejection are documented through notification email, but the required durable monitored controller and fail-closed terminal-action interface have not been established or tested.
